integrity: All scientific claims refer to the proved perfectness dichotomy and low-rank graph formula. Finite verification is corroboration, not proof of unbounded families. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The perfectness threshold assumes a finite commutative local ring with cube-zero maximal ideal and one-dimensional nonzero square ideal.
Full high-rank graph chromatic numbers and higher-dimensional square ideals are not classified.
A 2013 paper on individual rings of order p^4 and p^5 is accessible only by abstract, leaving possible overlap on the smallest example.
The alternating rank threshold has a published analogy in extraspecial-group commuting graphs; the result is not claimed independently for that analogy.
title: A bilinear-rank perfectness threshold for zero-divisor graphs of short local rings
